response.sql: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT SUM(Total) as customer_total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId),all_revenue AS (SELECT SUM(customer_total) as total_revenue FROM customer_totals),customer_shares AS (SELECT ct.customer_total, ct.customer_total / ar.total_revenue as customer_share FROM customer_totals ct, all_revenue ar),average_share AS (SELECT AVG(customer_share) as avg_share FROM customer_shares),above_average AS (SELECT cs.customer_total, cs.customer_share FROM customer_shares cs, average_share av WHERE cs.customer_share > av.avg_share)SELECT AVG(customer_total) as avg_spent, AVG(customer_share) as avg_share, AVG(customer_share) - (SELECT AVG(customer_share) FROM customer_shares) as avg_beat FROM above_average
